title: EventBus callback self-register during delivery contract

contract.self_register: A callback can register another callback during active event delivery
contract.current_delivery_isolation: A callback registered during an active emit does not receive that already-active event
contract.current_delivery_continuity: Registration during delivery does not interrupt existing callback delivery
contract.registry_update: The newly registered callback is added to the listener registry
contract.future_delivery_activation: A callback registered during one emit becomes active for subsequent emits
contract.delivery_order_preservation: Existing callbacks preserve their registered delivery order
contract.emit_success: EventBus.emit() remains successful after callback registration during delivery
contract.registry_stability: Self-registration during delivery does not corrupt the listener registry
contract.permission_enforcement: EventBus operations require the events permission
